name: Kintsugi
author: Erin Carter
description: Near-black porcelain repaired in real time: a handful of sparse, hand-drawn fissures each break as a hair of deeper black, flood in place from deep ember to liquid gold, settle into a quiet warm gleam, then mellow and yield their place to a new break elsewhere. No light ever travels along a seam — every brightening rises where it lies.

params.label: Cycle period
params.effect: Length in seconds of one seam's full break-flood-settle-fade lifecycle; short runs a busy kiln of frequent breaks, long stretches each mend into a rare contemplative event.

params.label: Seam width
params.effect: Width of the repair seams in CSS pixels — hairline lacquer at the minimum, generous molten channels at the maximum.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Intensity of the faint simmer on settled gold; 0 lets resting seams hold a perfectly steady gleam, 2 keeps every mended line quietly molten.
